`abstract class BorrowedTexture<H>`<br/>
**Implements:** [`ITexture`](/reference/bridges/itexture/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`GlBorrowedTexture`](/reference/base-opengl/glborrowedtexture/), [`VulkanBorrowedTexture`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanborrowedtexture/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.texture` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BorrowedTexture.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/texture/BorrowedTexture.java)

The base class of a texture that belongs to the host: JOID samples it and reads its size, and never allocates, writes or deletes it.

## Description

The handle comes from a supplier, read again at each use, so that the host can recreate its texture.

## Learn more

- [Lend a texture of the host](/build/resource-resolvers/#lend-a-texture-of-the-host)
